detail-reading.title: Find the tiny detail
detail-reading.label: Fine print
detail-reading.see: Start with the whole poster. Zoom only when the requested field is too small, keeping its label and section heading in the crop.
detail-reading.arrange: Keep the overview beside useful recent crops. Preserve original characters and source coordinates.
detail-reading.read: Match section and label, then transcribe the exact code. Preserve case, hyphens and leading zeros.

form-reading.title: Read the right field
form-reading.label: Forms
form-reading.see: Read the complete form before choosing a value. If needed, crop the label and value together.
form-reading.arrange: Keep columns, field boundaries and the page overview intact so neighboring identifiers stay distinct.
form-reading.read: Pair the requested label with its own value. Check nearby fields before returning the exact identifier.

chart-reading.title: Let the chart speak
chart-reading.label: Charts
chart-reading.see: Keep original colors, category labels and axis units. Inspect a bar pair or legend only when it is unclear.
chart-reading.arrange: Preserve the full chart as context; retain the legend and nearby ticks in detail views.
chart-reading.read: Match the series to its legend, read values with units, then compute the requested comparison.

table-reasoning.title: Follow the right rows
table-reasoning.label: Tables
table-reasoning.see: Read headers before numbers. Crop a row with its identifier, filter fields and target measure when necessary.
table-reasoning.arrange: Preserve row alignment and column structure. Keep the overview available while checking a detail.
table-reasoning.read: Apply every filter, collect values from the correct column, and verify the selected rows before summing.

object-counting.title: Count without losing track
object-counting.label: Counting
object-counting.see: Keep true RGB colors and object contours. Inspect only shapes whose color or boundary remains ambiguous.
object-counting.arrange: Use the scene's compartments or nonoverlapping scan bands. A crop shows existing objects, not new ones.
object-counting.read: Match both color and shape. Count region by region, check boundaries, then combine the subtotals.

image-comparison.title: Spot what changed
image-comparison.label: Before & after
image-comparison.see: Keep the input order, colors and aspect ratios. Compare both scenes before requesting matched detail crops.
image-comparison.arrange: Place the two views in an indexed, two-column comparison sheet while retaining source identities.
image-comparison.read: Align stable landmarks. For a moved object, confirm both its old location and its new location.

temporal-order.title: Put the story in order
temporal-order.label: Time & events
temporal-order.see: Retain the supplied event frames and timestamps. Inspect a specific source frame only when the event is unclear.
temporal-order.arrange: Arrange frames in a three-column, time-labeled sheet. Read timestamps rather than guessing from tile position.
temporal-order.read: Locate the anchor event, then inspect its immediate neighbor. Distinguish an action from a persistent state.

motion-state.title: Notice who stayed still
motion-state.label: Motion
motion-state.see: Keep all supplied frames in time order. Preserve the scene's colors and object identities.
motion-state.arrange: Use a time-labeled contact sheet so the same object can be compared across several moments.
motion-state.read: Track every object's position relative to stable landmarks. Returning to the start does not mean staying still.

multi-page-qa.title: Connect the pages
multi-page-qa.label: Documents
multi-page-qa.see: Retain the small report's page pool. Locate evidence by section headings and printed page numbers.
multi-page-qa.arrange: Keep pages individually addressable, with each fact tied to its source, period and units.
multi-page-qa.read: Find the required facts on their own pages, check that their entities and units agree, then combine them.

screen-grounding.title: Point to the right control
screen-grounding.label: Interfaces
screen-grounding.see: Inspect the original screenshot. Crop only when a repeated label or control is too small to distinguish.
screen-grounding.arrange: Preserve source geometry and individually addressable views. Never rearrange interface fragments into a sheet.
screen-grounding.read: Match the row and section qualifiers, then choose the control's center and return a normalized source point.
